name: Weaver-ant salt
summary: Weaver-ant salt, one of the dishes Kon Tum city put forward at its 2023 food festival beside gỏi lá, cơm lam, and grilled chicken. Across the Central Highlands, ant salt is a familiar dip for grilled chicken.
howToEat: Use it as a dip for grilled chicken.
seoDescription: Weaver-ant salt, a Kon Tum festival specialty and a Central Highlands dip for grilled chicken.
